title: Allele Tracker
role: Explore how drift, selection, mutation, and migration change allele frequencies over time.
description: An interactive population-genetics tool for comparing forces that shape variation and evolutionary change.

api.notes: A shared browser and node-consumable API module now exists for the first population-genetics remediation family.

tests.notes: A node-based contract test suite now exercises the shared family API module.

provenance.summary: Public evo-edu framing over the legacy PopG implementation.
provenance.details: Allele Tracker is the evo-edu public route built around the older PopG simulation. The remediation work now includes a responsive direct public workbench that uses the shared population-genetics API while preserving the legacy PopG runtime as an archive path.
lineage: Original model lineage: PopG, originally developed in FORTRAN by Prof. Joe Felsenstein and colleagues
Later JavaScript port named in the legacy route: Wesley R. Elsberry and OpenAI ChatGPT o1
limits: The legacy PopG runtime remains available as a memorialized archive path.
The shared API layer is in prototype status and deeper UI/API integration remains to be done.
Public deployment terms for this model family should be treated as requiring explicit compliance review under the original PopG notice.
provenance.license_risk_note: The original PopG notice includes distribution and revenue-related restrictions. Treat the current public route as based on PopG and subject to explicit compliance review rather than assuming independent relicensing.
